description:
Notes item for the registered feature batch `df-distinct-remediation`. It is never a batch member and carries no code change.

Why the batch exists: a remeasurement for a blog post (benchbox-site PR #143) found that TPC-DS DataFrame Q16/Q94/Q95 detect multi-warehouse orders with patterns that are slower than a min/max comparison. Reading the code then showed three further facts: (1) the DataFusion self-join branches compare `ctx.platform` with "datafusion" while the adapter reports "DataFusion", so they have been dead code since v0.1.1; (2) `UnifiedExpr.n_unique()` counts NULL as a value on Polars but not on PySpark or DataFusion, across about 50 call sites in 11 benchmarks; (3) the pandas-family Q94/Q95 helper counts an order with warehouses {1, NULL} as multi-warehouse.

Members, all independent (no implementation edges, disjoint scopes):
- `tpcds-df-multi-warehouse-min-max`
- `df-n-unique-null-semantics`
- `df-q21-multi-supplier-min-max`

Owner decisions recorded 2026-11-12:
- Three members as above; the Q21 member lands its query change only if its timing gate passes.
- Timing gates wait for an idle machine; the final PR is not armed before every timing gate has a recorded outcome.
- The shared `n_unique()` method is fixed, not only TPC-DS.
- Members run as subagents of the leader session for this batch. This overrides the rule in docs/agent/batch-feature-delivery.md that a member never runs as a subagent of its leader; members are told to make no tracker call.
- If the batch-v2 capability is missing or `make batch-start` refuses, deliver the same three items on one feature branch and one PR (serial feature-branch mode) without asking again.
- Post one comment on benchbox-site PR #143: BenchBox never ran the DataFusion self-join, so the draft's claim needs rewording.
- The DuckDB `<2.0.0` cap is lifted on its own pull request, outside this batch.
